:::{#exm-outer-product-trace}
#### The trace of an outer product

For $\vecf{a} = (1, 2)$ and $\vecf{b} = (3, 4)$,
[the remark on outer and dot products](linear-algebra.qmd#rem-outer-vs-dot-product)
found the [outer product](linear-algebra.qmd#def-outer-product) $\oprod{\vecf{a}}{\vecf{b}}$
and the [dot product](linear-algebra.qmd#def-dot-product) $\tprod{\vecf{a}}{\vecf{b}} = 11$.
The [trace](#def-trace) of the outer product is

$$
\ba
\trf{\oprod{\vecf{a}}{\vecf{b}}}
&= \trf{\begin{bmatrix} 3 & 4 \\ 6 & 8 \end{bmatrix}}
&& \text{(the outer product found in the remark)}
\\
&= 3 + 8
&& \text{(definition of the trace)}
\\
&= 11
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

The trace equals the dot product,
as @thm-outer-product-trace says.
